title: 第13章 其他修士第14章 赵星辰
lines: 汽车直接开到了别墅的大门口，我的车门也被拉开。
“白小兄弟，里边请吧。”
赵乾依旧是那笑咪咪的模样。
说实话，我挺讨厌他这副样子的。
没有说话，我踏进了别墅的大门，大门很厚重，厚的有些不像话，看起来像是防弹的，地面是光滑的通体大理石，纹路细腻，质感出众，房间的装修以红色为主，看起来端庄大方。
“走去二楼。”
赵乾没有废话，直接领着我上去。
别墅里的电梯很宽大，房间的挑高很高，赵乾直接领着上了电梯。
二楼跟跟一楼完全不一样，入眼就是一间宽大的房间，里面摆满了各种医疗仪器，一旁甚至站着二十多人的医疗团队，看到赵乾到来赶忙停下手里的工作，冲着赵乾点头示意。
往里走去，一间明亮的房间中，宽大的床上躺着一位老人。
老人身上并没有任何仪器，安详得躺在那里，仿佛睡着了一般。
而我却眉头紧皱。
刚才一进门我就发现了些许不对劲，这个不对劲并不是赵乾有什么坏心思，而是眼前这老人不对劲。
我在他身上感觉到了“气“的存在！
虽然不强，但是却在他身上上下游离，仿佛在紧固着他一般！
这是我第一次在我的世界中看到“气”
的存在！
赵乾显然是发现了我的不对劲。
“白兄弟，你是看出了些什么吗？”
赵乾的语气都有些变了，他也失去了先前从容的笑脸，变得有些严肃起来。
我点了点头，随后，又摇了摇头。
“说不好。”
然后我来到了老者的身旁。
“你们先出去吧，我自己待一会。”
听到我的话，其他人都看向赵乾。
赵乾显然也有些犹豫了，毕竟我这是第一次见到我，甚至都不知道我的品行会不会对这老者造成伤害，毕竟这老人的身份不一般！
赵乾有些拿不定主意了。
他不敢去博。
我看了赵乾一眼。
“不放心的话，你留下吧，但是不要打扰我。”
我的话令赵乾松了口气，随即一挥手，其他人全部离开，而赵乾也站在一旁，一扫之前的慵懒，身姿端正，直直的站在那里，就连呼吸都调整的很悠长轻微，显然害怕打扰到我。
我也顾不上赵乾，之前我还挺抵触来到这里，但是这老人身上居然存在“气”
，这不得我勾起了我的兴趣，要知道这几天我虽然跟周黎在外面乱玩，但是我一直没有现在，晚上一直坚持修行寻找“气”
的存在！
闭上眼睛，我把手搭在老人身上。
老人的气息其实很微弱了，这种微弱不同于行将就木，更像是力竭一般！
当我的手一接触这道“气”
后，这道气就变得狂暴起来，顺着我的手就传导了我的身上。
我一愣，这不是天然存在的“气”
这是其他修士的灵气！
content_en:
The car drove directly to the gate of the villa, and my car door was opened.
"Brother Bai, please come inside."
Zhao Qian still looked like he was smiling.
To be honest, I quite hate him looking like this.
Without saying a word, I stepped into the door of the villa. The door was very heavy, a little too thick, and looked bulletproof. The floor was made of smooth marble with fine lines and outstanding texture. The decoration of the room was mainly red, which looked dignified and generous.
"Go to the second floor."
Zhao Qian didn't talk nonsense and led me up directly.
The elevator in the villa is very spacious and the room has a high ceiling. Zhao Qian led him directly to the elevator.
The second floor is completely different from the first floor. The first thing you see is a large room filled with various medical instruments. There is even a medical team of more than 20 people standing beside it. When Zhao Qian arrived, he quickly stopped what he was doing and nodded to Zhao Qian.
Walking inside, there was an old man lying on a large bed in a bright room.
The old man didn't have any instruments on his body, and he lay there peacefully, as if he was asleep.
But I frowned.
As soon as I walked in, I noticed something was wrong. This was not because Zhao Qian had any bad intentions, but because something was wrong with the old man in front of me.
I felt the presence of "qi" in him!
"Qi"
Although it is not strong, it moves up and down his body, as if it is tightening him!
This is the first time I see "Qi" in Minecraft
existence!
Zhao Qian obviously noticed something was wrong with me.
"Brother Bai, did you see something?"
Zhao Qian's tone changed a little, and he lost his previous calm smile and became a little serious.
I nodded, then shook my head.
"Can't tell."
Then I came to the old man's side.
"You guys go out first, I'll stay by myself for a while."
After hearing my words, everyone else looked at Zhao Qian.
Zhao Qian was obviously hesitant. After all, this was the first time he saw me. He didn’t even know if my character would cause harm to the old man. After all, the old man’s status was extraordinary!
Zhao Qian was a little undecided.
He didn't dare to gamble.
I glanced at Zhao Qian.
"If you're not worried, you can stay, but don't disturb me."
My words made Zhao Qian breathe a sigh of relief. Then he waved his hand and everyone else left. Zhao Qian also stood aside. He wiped away his previous laziness and stood upright. Even his breathing was long and gentle. He was obviously afraid of disturbing me.
I couldn't care less about Zhao Qian. I was quite resistant to coming here before, but this old man actually has "qi" in him.
, this aroused my interest. You must know that although Zhou Li and I have been playing outside these days, I have never been like this. I have been practicing in the evening to find "Qi"
existence!
I closed my eyes and put my hands on the old man.
The old man's breath is actually very weak. This feebleness is different from dying, but more like exhaustion!
As soon as my hand touches this "qi"
After that, the energy became violent and spread to my body along my hands.
I was stunned, this is not a naturally occurring "qi"
This is the aura of other monks!
title_en: Chapter 13 Other Monks Chapter 14 Zhao Xingchen
